name: Weather-Prediction
description: This is a Hackathon project we did on Solving for India Hackathon conducted by GeeksforGeeks, Powered by Google and AMD.                    This Web App is hosted on render as it is free and it will take some time for loading and as it is hosted on free service the processing time is also higher

paragraphs: This project uses a machine learning model to predict the weather for the next five hours and gives the current weather data of your area. With the predicted data the model gives information, whether to irrigate your agricultural field. It also contains some information related to some efficient irrigation methods that will be helpful for farmers.

For data collection, we use Open-Weather API to get the hourly data of past 48 hours and predict the temperature and humidity for next 5 hours of the given place. The website also displays the current weather conditions of the same place.

For weather prediction the model uses a popular Time-series Forecasting algorithm called ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average). This model is a combination of the Auto Regression (AR) model and the Moving Average (MA) model.
